words: Every single thing on the list should be ready and waiting for me - not one of them missing, or the whole lot is like a seed tray with half the seedlings gone. All told I've 60500 US cents to spend - that's the full pot and nothing more behind it. So here's the list - 1 x computer monitors with a refresh rate of 75 hz at most - then 2 x streaming media players with 6k resolution and a plug type of universal or US - and 1 x antennas and coax cables with an n-type male connector type. The streaming media players needs to be one that suits the chosen computer monitors. Get the total down as far as it'll go. The antennas and coax cables needs to be one that suits the chosen computer monitors. If the panel type of the computer monitors you pick is va, the material of the antennas and coax cables has to be copper. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. We've 111 steps - then we're finished - done or not.
